en-US.title: DuelTastic
en-US.subtitle: Four Duel Games. No Ads.
en-US.promoText: LightCycles, Turf, Tag and Snake in one app. Play a friend face to face on one phone, or take on the CPU, with no ads and no tracking.
en-US.description:
Four arcade duel games in one app: LightCycles, Turf, Tag and Snake. Play a friend face to face on one device, or the CPU. No ads, no accounts.

• LightCycles: the classic light-trail duel. Every rider leaves a solid trail, so box the other rider in and be the last one riding. Five arenas and six optional powerups
• Turf: loop out from your ground to claim more of the board, and cut the other rider's trail before they get home. Most ground at the buzzer wins
• Tag: the playground classic. Catch the other rider, then run before they catch you back
• Snake: the arcade classic. Eat, grow, and keep off the walls. Play alone for a high score, or against a second snake
• Two Player face to face on one device, or One Player against the CPU at three difficulties
• Set each game's speed, grid size, rules and optional powerups
• Player profiles, stats, and 123 achievements across the four games
• A match pauses when you leave the app
• Light and dark mode, on iPhone and iPad
• Plays offline

Part of the Tastic family of games. Your player profiles are shared with the other Tastic games on your device.

Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/jayrdeaton/LightCycles
